scope: Three complete ingest/view-build/publication files; only redundant smoke/literal/allocation tests removed. Pending rewrites remain intact.
runtime_status: Fresh cab7cdf38-based candidate with exact compatibility prerequisites is pending required fast/T1, affected local-service T2, and local-service T3. No passing or flake-rate claim.

removed.name: unchanged_files_reuse_the_exact_declaration_allocation
removed.reason: The isolated one-file test checks source_version equality, declaration Arc pointer identity, and compiler_sources empty after unchanged rescan. This is useful allocation detail but the stronger retained `reused_scan_drops_compiler_text_until_a_sibling_edit` exercises the same unchanged-Arc and dropped compiler-text law with realistic two-file sizes, then proves sibling edit reprocesses only changed source, exact content identities reopen through the root capability, and TOCTOU edits are refused without echoing bytes. Keep the stronger test; the smaller one is redundant.
removed.replacement_required: crates/local-service/src/builtin/ingest.rs::reused_scan_drops_compiler_text_until_a_sibling_edit (existing stronger test; no new replacement needed)

removed.name: the_stale_note_is_stable
removed.reason: DELETE: Body only checks a shared constant contains one phrase, adding no distinct failure case; it can pass while stale behavior is wrong and fails if wording changes harmlessly. Existing `a_stale_image_answers_semantic_with_a_typed_stale_note` and `a_stale_publication_suppresses_structural_rows_instead_of_silently_falling_back` exercise the user-visible stale projection and typed lane, so no new replacement is needed.

removed.name: structural_fixture_plans_the_workspace_and_one_package
removed.reason: DELETE: The body only checks that project_structural_plan returns Ok for a four-file workspace and a two-file package, without inspecting either plan or asserting a distinct result. Concrete structural output and retained parent/sibling behavior are exercised by `one_file_keeps_the_attached_parent_and_the_sibling_bytes`; package splice behavior is exercised by `splicing_one_package_keeps_the_sibling_bytes_and_rejects_a_stolen_id`. No additional replacement is needed.

reviewed_tests.name: cancellable_project_scan_stops_before_opening_the_workspace
reviewed_tests.reason: Pre-cancelled scan against a nonexistent path returns the fixed cancellation error, proving cancellation is checked before opening the root. Prevents unnecessary filesystem access after cancellation; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: structural_frontend_inventory_has_exactly_one_parser_per_language
reviewed_tests.reason: Builds production frontend registry and requires every SourceLanguage has a parser with nonzero producer identity. Protects parser inventory/provenance; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: discovery_budget_is_checked_before_an_entry_is_retained
reviewed_tests.reason: At MAX_DISCOVERY_ENTRIES and MAX_DIRECTORY_ENTRIES, admitting one more entry errors. Pins global and per-directory resource bounds before retention; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: opened_project_root_rejects_symlink_substitution
reviewed_tests.reason: Opened root admits ordinary confined source but refuses a file symlink and a directory symlink substituted after root capability open. Protects source confinement against path substitution; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: every_language_lane_uses_its_grammar_tags
reviewed_tests.reason: Seven representative Rust/Python/TS/Go/Java/C#/C++ snippets are routed to their language frontend and each expected declaration appears. Protects language-to-grammar routing; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: scanned_files_persist_the_semantic_source_content_identity
reviewed_tests.reason: Scans exact Rust bytes and checks persisted source identity equals semantic SourceFactDomain digest and differs for altered bytes. Keeps view/file provenance comparable; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: unchanged_files_reuse_the_exact_declaration_allocation
reviewed_tests.reason: The isolated one-file test checks source_version equality, declaration Arc pointer identity, and compiler_sources empty after unchanged rescan. This is useful allocation detail but the stronger retained `reused_scan_drops_compiler_text_until_a_sibling_edit` exercises the same unchanged-Arc and dropped compiler-text law with realistic two-file sizes, then proves sibling edit reprocesses only changed source, exact content identities reopen through the root capability, and TOCTOU edits are refused without echoing bytes. Keep the stronger test; the smaller one is redundant.
reviewed_tests.replacement_required: crates/local-service/src/builtin/ingest.rs::reused_scan_drops_compiler_text_until_a_sibling_edit (existing stronger test; no new replacement needed)

reviewed_tests.name: reused_scan_drops_compiler_text_until_a_sibling_edit
reviewed_tests.reason: Cold scan holds compiler handles smaller than source text; warm scan drops all compiler text and reuses exact declaration allocations; one sibling edit emits only changed source and preserves the other Arc; admission reopens both exact bytes and rejects fresh/reused post-hash edits without echoing torn text. This is a distinct memory, incremental and handoff law; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: unavailable_bytes_are_not_reused_as_compiler_input
reviewed_tests.reason: Invalid UTF-8 Rust bytes produce no fresh or reused compiler handle on both cold and warm scan. Prevents previously unavailable content being smuggled into a compiler as reusable input; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: admit_rejects_a_path_present_in_both_lists
reviewed_tests.reason: Same relative path appears as fresh and reused with conflicting content; handoff rejects exact path as admitted twice. Prevents duplicate authority paths with ambiguous byte source; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: indexed_source_excerpt_recovers_only_exact_confined_bytes
reviewed_tests.reason: Excerpt recovery succeeds only when source identity, line, declaration kind and root-confined path match; wrong line/kind, parent traversal, changed/deleted file and symlink all return none. Protects byte-exact snippet recovery; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: admit_refuses_a_reused_file_replaced_by_a_symlink
reviewed_tests.reason: Warm reusable source path replaced with symlink to secret outside file is refused, naming path but not leaking content. Protects compiler handoff confinement and error confidentiality; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: git_frontier_warm_scan_reads_no_source_bytes_with_ignored_build_output
reviewed_tests.reason: Cold Git scan reads only tracked Rust file, ignoring target output; warm frontier rereads zero source bytes and retains same version. Protects warm fast path and ignore boundary; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: changed_source_quota_invalidates_warm_frontier_before_file_admission
reviewed_tests.reason: Changing admission policy identity/tightening max file size invalidates prior reusable compiler file; scanner reads no source but records TooLarge and emits no compiler handle. Prevents prior policy admitting data over new quota; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: complete_fact_pages_exceeding_the_project_quota_refuse_before_retention
reviewed_tests.reason: Real TS parser emits multiple complete fact pages whose aggregate exceeds project record quota; scan refuses before retention, then retry under default policy succeeds identically. Protects complete-page aggregate budget and recoverability; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: warm_frontier_charges_unchanged_fact_pages_after_another_file_grows
reviewed_tests.reason: Seeds warm cached pages for 1,000 declarations, proves unchanged refresh retains full page charges without reads, then growing only second file exceeds project quota only when unchanged cached charges are included. Prevents warm cache bypass of aggregate quotas; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: many_small_files_85_mib_cold_and_warm_scans_obey_admission_and_memory_caps
reviewed_tests.reason: 10,880 tracked 8 KiB files (>84 MiB) cold scan admits all under project/retained limits and checks in-flight worker buffers fit; materialization byte total is exact, warm scan reads zero bytes and retains all handles. Protects high-count memory/admission bounds; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: one_valid_generated_tsx_over_512_kib_is_scanned_and_reopened
reviewed_tests.reason: Valid 768 KiB generated TSX below per-file limit gets TSX profile, exact input digest/source identity, then root-confined handoff reopens exact bytes. Protects realistic large-file acceptance across scan and compiler handoff; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: compiler_handoff_rejects_retargeted_root_alias_with_identical_source
reviewed_tests.reason: Symlink alias initially points to admitted root then retargets to foreign root containing identical bytes; handoff refuses directory identity change. Content equality cannot substitute for root capability; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: compiler_workspace_rejects_retargeted_ancestor_alias_with_identical_files
reviewed_tests.reason: Workspace snapshot anchored through aliased parent revalidates false after alias points to another parent with identical project files. Protects ancestor capability identity across delayed compilation; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: compiler_handoff_rejects_root_replacement_with_identical_source
reviewed_tests.reason: Renames admitted project directory and creates replacement at same path with identical source; compiler handoff refuses changed root inode. Protects root identity rather than path/content-only checks; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: unchanged_tmp_alias_resolves_to_its_admitted_private_tmp_root
reviewed_tests.reason: macOS /tmp alias legitimately canonicalizes under /private/tmp; scan/handoff and workspace snapshot accept stable alias and exact bytes. Keeps confinement compatible with documented platform alias; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: compiler_materialization_cancellation_stops_before_the_next_source_read
reviewed_tests.reason: After first of two sorted source handles materializes, callback cancels; materializer returns fixed cancellation before reading changed second file. Protects cooperative cancellation and avoids unnecessary reads; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: git_frontier_reads_only_an_edited_file_and_handles_rename_delete
reviewed_tests.reason: Warm Git frontier rereads only edited file; after rename it reads changed and renamed bytes, removes old path and admits new. Protects incremental correctness across tracked edits/rename; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: git_frontier_falls_back_for_new_untracked_source_and_ignore_policy_change
reviewed_tests.reason: New untracked source causes safe full read; after removing it, changing .gitignore admits formerly hidden nested source and reads selected files. Prevents stale Git frontier when untracked paths/selection rules change; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: git_frontier_witnesses_a_local_ignore_file_hidden_by_gitignore
reviewed_tests.reason: Root .gitignore hides local .ignore from ordinary selection, but its content is witnessed; editing it makes hidden source visible and forces correct full source reads. Protects selection policy inputs even when ignored; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: git_frontier_falls_back_when_a_selected_path_is_a_symlink
reviewed_tests.reason: A selected project path becomes a symlink to external source; frontier falls back but only reads safe stable file and excludes symlink. Protects Git optimization from weakening confinement; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: git_frontier_detects_mutation_after_a_zero_read_reuse_attempt
reviewed_tests.reason: Deterministic race mutates tracked source after zero-read frontier decision; fallback reads changed plus unchanged file and emits changed file's exact content digest. Protects mutation detection at optimization boundary; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: cold_frontier_reopen_uses_the_full_source_read
reviewed_tests.reason: Clears process-local frontier state then warm data cannot justify no-read reuse; cold reopen rereads source and retains same version. Protects restart behavior independent of hot cache; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: raw_crlf_lf_change_with_the_same_git_blob_is_reread
reviewed_tests.reason: Equal-length CRLF/LF swap leaves normalized Git blob/status unchanged but changes raw bytes; scanner rereads file and content version changes. Prevents Git normalization from hiding compiler-input changes; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: benchmark_git_frontier_reads_large_fixture_once_then_reuses_all_rows
reviewed_tests.reason: Builds 1,024 generated tracked sources plus root file (~4 MiB), cold-scans, then warm-scans from prior rows; requires all 1,025 rows and zero warm source bytes, logging timings only. Keep as large-tree cold/warm scale characterization; timing is not a CI gate.

reviewed_tests.name: a_changed_language_does_not_reread_an_unchanged_one
reviewed_tests.reason: Two languages are cached; Rust changes, then Python changes after snapshot. Lost-profile selection remains empty but handoff admits only Rust captured bytes and does not reread/compile Python. Protects per-language delta isolation and fence detection; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: a_deleted_language_does_not_reread_the_languages_that_remain
reviewed_tests.reason: Deletes Python file while Rust remains unchanged then mutates Rust post-scan; Python profile is lost, Rust is not, and handoff admits nothing rather than stale Rust. Protects deleted-language retirement and unchanged-lane safety; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: one_rust_edition_does_not_reread_another_crate
reviewed_tests.reason: Edits Rust 2018 crate, leaves Rust 2021 crate unchanged but mutates it post-scan; only 2018 bytes are admitted and both manifests still resolve correct edition. Protects per-crate profile isolation; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: a_deleted_crate_retires_its_edition_after_the_manifest_is_gone
reviewed_tests.reason: Two Rust editions and Python are live; deleting 2018 crate removes only that profile, keeps other profiles, and retirement selects 2018 while compile set remains subset of live profiles. Prevents stale edition authority after manifest deletion; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: a_file_denser_than_one_row_is_indexed_rather_than_rejected
reviewed_tests.reason: 140 declarations exceed row capacity; scan keeps record within cap with ExcerptsElided retention, first/last names and all signatures intact. Protects useful bounded shedding instead of whole-file rejection; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: a_file_within_one_row_keeps_complete_retention_and_its_excerpts
reviewed_tests.reason: Small documented function remains Complete with captured excerpt. Pins no unnecessary degradation under capacity; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: shedding_is_a_pure_function_of_the_source
reviewed_tests.reason: Two cold scans of same dense source yield identical source version and identical rows. Prevents content-addressed relation churn from nondeterministic shedding; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: python_unavailable_resources_keep_baseline_rows_and_exact_compiler_frontier
reviewed_tests.reason: Valid Python and invalid stub/Latin-1 files each keep raw-source compiler handles and exact digests, while syntax decode failures are per-file Unparsed/NotText; valid sibling declaration survives and handoff preserves original bytes. Protects raw byte/compiler frontier distinction; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: an_unreadable_file_is_reported_without_failing_the_project
reviewed_tests.reason: When mode bits make one file genuinely unreadable, it is retained as typed Unreadable while neighboring valid source is Complete and searchable; skips assertion if test user bypasses permissions. Protects per-file error isolation; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: a_binary_file_is_reported_as_not_text_without_failing_the_project
reviewed_tests.reason: Binary invalid UTF-8 is charged by exact raw byte count and marked NotText; readable sibling still contributes declaration. Protects byte accounting and typed partial scan; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: valid_non_ascii_source_keeps_exact_bytes_and_content_identity
reviewed_tests.reason: UTF-8 Rust source with café is read/hashed byte-exactly, persisted identity and compiler handle agree, declaration survives. Protects Unicode content fidelity; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: an_oversized_file_is_reported_as_too_large_without_failing_the_project
reviewed_tests.reason: One file exceeds per-file limit and is retained TooLarge, while good neighbor remains indexed. Protects typed failure without workspace failure; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: gitignored_sources_are_excluded_while_negated_sources_are_admitted
reviewed_tests.reason: Root ignore and nested src/* exclude files while explicit negation admits src/keep.rs and ordinary good file. Pins ignore precedence; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: a_symlink_cycle_is_skipped_and_the_project_still_indexes
reviewed_tests.reason: Directory symlink cycle and file alias are skipped without recursion/duplicate admission; real file remains searchable. Protects safe traversal and project survivability; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: a_unicode_path_is_indexed_under_its_exact_coordinate
reviewed_tests.reason: Unicode nested directory/file name round-trips as exact path and row remains Complete with declaration. Protects path portability/fidelity for Unicode; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: a_file_removed_during_the_scan_leaves_the_project_indexable
reviewed_tests.reason: Confirms file was discovered then deletes it before scan_file; vanished path returns None and valid neighbor still indexes. Protects discovery/read race as absence rather than fatal error; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: an_unavailable_file_becomes_available_again_when_it_can_be_read
reviewed_tests.reason: Invalid UTF-8 row is initially NotText; after replacing bytes with valid Rust, next cold scan becomes Complete, source version changes and declaration appears. Prevents cached unavailable status persisting after repair; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: every_claimed_extension_resolves_to_its_own_language_profile
reviewed_tests.reason: Iterates every frontend-claimed extension, requires a profile in the same language and nonzero inventory size; catches discovery/profile table drift that can break whole projects. Keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: javascript_and_python_stub_extensions_carry_their_dialect
reviewed_tests.reason: Pins JS module extensions to TS, JSX/TSX to TSX, Python py/pyw to Python, Objective-C .m to C, and .mm to C++; protects dialect selection; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: an_unprofiled_extension_is_unavailable_and_not_fatal
reviewed_tests.reason: Unknown .qq produces typed Unparsed availability fault while known postcss.config.js is accepted. Prevents one unsupported extension aborting project scan; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: a_javascript_project_indexes_its_config_and_skips_framework_caches
reviewed_tests.reason: Real root postcss config and TS app contribute declarations while oversized .angular and .next caches are never traversed. Protects useful config admission and cache exclusion; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: discovery_skips_every_directory_the_csharp_oracle_skips
reviewed_tests.reason: Shared discovery hard-ignores obj/.git/.vs/node_modules matching C# oracle while leaves bin alone for other languages. Prevents frontend disagreement; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: discovery_skips_framework_and_tool_caches
reviewed_tests.reason: Pins 23 tool/framework caches as ignored and src as ordinary source directory. Protects bounded discovery policy; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: snapshot_captures_python_build_package_bytes_and_fences_package_marker_changes
reviewed_tests.reason: Workspace snapshot includes nested Python build package source and binary data, excludes unrelated top-level build output, then detects package marker removal. Protects completeness and package topology fence; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: snapshot_inventory_includes_root_config_zero_byte_files_and_fences_new_paths
reviewed_tests.reason: Snapshot includes root config, zero-byte file, root entry and policy identity; excludes target output, supports bounded exact read/chunk stream, and invalidates on newly created path. Protects exact workspace inventory; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: snapshot_fence_detects_content_and_metadata_changes
reviewed_tests.reason: Changing file bytes invalidates captured workspace snapshot and subsequent read refuses stale content. Protects delayed compiler input fence; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: snapshot_fence_detects_same_length_edit_after_last_write_is_restored
reviewed_tests.reason: Windows-only test restores last-write time and preserves length/file ID after same-size edit but observes change-time difference; snapshot and reads refuse. Protects metadata-based fence against timestamp restoration; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: snapshot_rejects_junctions_and_hardlink_aliases
reviewed_tests.reason: Windows-only fixture adds junction to outside directory then hardlink to outside file; both cause snapshot admission refusal. Protects reparse/hardlink confinement; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: workspace_paths_must_be_utf8_nfc_and_portable
reviewed_tests.reason: Accepts ordinary relative path, applies platform-correct backslash handling, rejects decomposed Unicode. Protects cross-platform canonical path identity; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: case_colliding_names_fail_portable_workspace_admission
reviewed_tests.reason: On case-sensitive host, Foo/foo distinct files cause portable snapshot refusal; skips assertion where filesystem aliases them. Prevents ambiguous cross-platform paths; keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: snapshot_rejects_symlinks_instead_of_silently_omitting_them
reviewed_tests.reason: An external symlink inside workspace makes complete snapshot fail rather than silently omit authority-changing path. Keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: snapshot_rejects_special_files_instead_of_admitting_them
reviewed_tests.reason: Unix socket in project causes snapshot refusal, preventing nonregular special inputs from being treated as source files. Keep internal.

reviewed_tests.name: a_semantic_row_reads_deprecation_from_its_captured_attributes_and_docs
reviewed_tests.reason: Builds a Java semantic image with captured deprecated attribute and docs, an ordinary fresh item, and an unobserved attribute plane; projected rows distinguish since/note, absent, and unobserved states. Protects evidence availability and native deprecation extraction.

reviewed_tests.name: a_go_interface_method_is_required_and_a_deprecated_paragraph_is_read
reviewed_tests.reason: Builds Go interface/method and documented function rows from captured facts, requiring interface method Required obligation, ordinary function absent obligation, and exact Deprecated paragraph extraction. Covers Go native projection nuance.

reviewed_tests.name: a_structural_row_carries_its_facts_and_no_invented_documentation
reviewed_tests.reason: Runs actual Rust syntax frontend on deprecated documented and bare functions; structural projection preserves deprecation/doc text and leaves undocumented row document empty. Prevents invented docs on fallback rows.

reviewed_tests.name: duplicate_structural_coordinates_keep_each_identity_and_close_parent_edges
reviewed_tests.reason: Constructs C module, same-coordinate struct/type duplicates, and enclosing field; requires duplicate identities invariant to declaration order, retained identity preimages, and parent resolution to a deterministic symbol within duplicate set.

reviewed_tests.name: frontend_duplicate_coordinates_are_retained_without_a_dangling_target
reviewed_tests.reason: Runs actual C# frontend namespace fixture through structural planning, requiring retained duplicate namespace captures to have distinct identity IDs and valid per-row preimages rather than dangling/collapsed references.

reviewed_tests.name: rust_impl_trait_duplicate_method_kinds_keep_preimages_and_parentage
reviewed_tests.reason: Constructs Rust same-coordinate method/function declarations in a Worker impl, reverses input and requires stable distinct IDs and exact preimages plus Worker symbol parentage. Guards duplicate-kind tie-breaking and graph closure.

reviewed_tests.name: cross_profile_attached_parent_falls_back_to_an_emitted_module
reviewed_tests.reason: Builds mixed C structural and Rust semantic source where C method attaches to a Rust type suppressed by complete semantic publication; requires method to remain emitted under C module fallback and validates all row/query-fact parent edges resolve. Protects cross-profile projection closure.

reviewed_tests.name: repeated_tag_coordinates_keep_distinct_checked_identity_preimages
reviewed_tests.reason: Creates method/function tag collision at one coordinate and proves deterministic distinct identity preimages independent of declaration order; unique TypeScript coordinate remains compact without extra preimage. Guards stable symbol IDs.

reviewed_tests.name: declarations_are_parented_to_their_type_and_not_to_the_file
reviewed_tests.reason: Checks a representative projected Rust hierarchy: type members parent to Worker/Event, top-level execute parents to module, and module has no parent. Protects public graph structure across methods, fields, enum variants and top-level functions.

reviewed_tests.name: an_attached_method_row_keeps_the_type_symbol_as_its_parent
reviewed_tests.reason: Checks the actual projected `run` row has Method kind and Worker symbol parent, preventing loss of source container attachment.

reviewed_tests.name: the_structural_fallback_answers_with_typed_provenance
reviewed_tests.reason: Requires fallback rows to contain no semantic coordinates and ledger to record Structural(NoCompletePublication), not semantic freshness, for exactly the fixture file.

reviewed_tests.name: the_semantic_lane_answers_fields_and_variants_the_baseline_cannot_see
reviewed_tests.reason: Verifies semantic image projection emits field and enum variant with semantic coordinates and parents them to Worker and Event; covers declarations unavailable in compact baseline parser rows.

reviewed_tests.name: a_stale_image_answers_semantic_with_a_typed_stale_note
reviewed_tests.reason: Compares fresh and stale semantic projections: stale preserves row count and semantic addressing while adding a typed stale note to each row; fresh rows remain unmarked. Prevents stale data from silently falling back to structural coordinates.

reviewed_tests.name: a_stale_publication_suppresses_structural_rows_instead_of_silently_falling_back
reviewed_tests.reason: Runs real Rust frontend source through projection with that profile explicitly complete but file marked stale; requires Semantic(Stale) lane and forbids structural coordinates. Guards fail-closed freshness routing.

reviewed_tests.name: an_in_place_edit_marks_only_the_edited_file_stale_and_suppresses_structure_for_both
reviewed_tests.reason: Projects two real Rust source rows under complete publication with one path marked edited; edited lane is semantic stale, untouched lane semantic fresh, and neither falls back to structural address. Preserves per-file freshness precision.

reviewed_tests.name: an_unavailable_publication_types_the_structural_cause_with_its_reason
reviewed_tests.reason: Marks Rust publication unavailable for Toolchain, then verifies structural declarations remain answerable and ledger carries Structural(PublicationUnavailable(Toolchain)); unavailable is not confused with no publication or stale image.

reviewed_tests.name: freshness_compares_compiled_paths_against_the_current_scan
reviewed_tests.reason: Compares semantic image source path/content against exact, expanded, legacy-without-identity, and deleted current scans; requires only new file stale when identity is available, all paths stale for imprecise legacy mismatch, and changed path set detected on deletion.

reviewed_tests.name: an_in_place_edit_is_stale_without_a_path_set_change
reviewed_tests.reason: Keeps same path set but swaps source content identity, requiring that specific image stale; same compiled identity stays fresh. Catches path-set-only freshness blind spot.

reviewed_tests.name: records_without_identities_keep_the_path_set_fallback
reviewed_tests.reason: Exercises old persisted image with no source identity: unchanged path set stays fresh but added current path makes the whole current set stale, never claiming per-file evidence it lacks.

reviewed_tests.name: complete_c_publication_does_not_suppress_cxx_fallback
reviewed_tests.reason: Asserts profile completeness is extension/language specific: complete C23 publication suppresses `.c` structural fallback but not `.cpp` fallback.

reviewed_tests.name: the_stale_note_is_stable
reviewed_tests.reason: DELETE: Body only checks a shared constant contains one phrase, adding no distinct failure case; it can pass while stale behavior is wrong and fails if wording changes harmlessly. Existing `a_stale_image_answers_semantic_with_a_typed_stale_note` and `a_stale_publication_suppresses_structural_rows_instead_of_silently_falling_back` exercise the user-visible stale projection and typed lane, so no new replacement is needed.

reviewed_tests.name: cross_file_call_typescript_named_import
reviewed_tests.reason: Runs actual TypeScript parsing of named import and caller plus an unimported decoy; requires exact outgoing and incoming Calls edge for imported target and none for decoy.

reviewed_tests.name: cross_file_call_typescript_alias_import
reviewed_tests.reason: Parses aliased named import and requires local alias invocation to resolve to original exported function, with no edge to sibling export.

reviewed_tests.name: cross_file_call_typescript_imported_class_method
reviewed_tests.reason: Parses imported WorkoutService instance method call with another class exposing same method name; resolves only receiver-typed imported class target.

reviewed_tests.name: cross_file_call_typescript_ambiguous_imported_class_method
reviewed_tests.reason: Imports two classes with identical method names but caller receiver type is ambiguous; requires no Calls edges to either candidate or elsewhere, avoiding guessed graph edges.

reviewed_tests.name: cross_file_call_typescript_property_name_does_not_matter
reviewed_tests.reason: Changes instance property name from class name to `svc` while retaining WorkoutService type and requires call resolve to its class method, binding by declared receiver type rather than property spelling.

reviewed_tests.name: cross_file_call_typescript_type_only_import_skipped
reviewed_tests.reason: Uses TypeScript `import type` for a class instance and requires member invocation to create no runtime Calls relation; prevents type-only edges from being treated as executable imports.

reviewed_tests.name: cross_file_call_same_file_unchanged
reviewed_tests.reason: Confirms same-file Rust direct invocation produces Calls edge while string-literal decoy mentioning same call does not; regression fence for extraction behavior as cross-file parser evolves.

reviewed_tests.name: cross_file_call_rust_use_path
reviewed_tests.reason: Parses Rust `use crate::apply::entries_from_items` and a caller in another file, requiring one exact source-qualified Calls target.

reviewed_tests.name: cross_file_call_python_from_import
reviewed_tests.reason: Parses Python `from apply_set import entries_from_items` and function caller, requiring exact cross-file Calls target resolution.

reviewed_tests.name: cross_file_call_typescript_namespace_qualifier
reviewed_tests.reason: Parses namespace import and qualified invocation as edge, while unqualified call without import remains unlinked; distinguishes module qualification from global same-name lookup.

reviewed_tests.name: cross_file_call_earlier_punctuation_does_not_qualify
reviewed_tests.reason: Places nested property access, punctuation-like `::` string, and object property before a later imported call; requires later real call still resolve, guarding brittle prefix token parsing.

reviewed_tests.name: cross_file_call_namespace_not_poisoned_by_earlier_property
reviewed_tests.reason: Places object property named like import namespace before a bare call and valid qualified call; bare call has no edge and qualified call resolves correctly, preventing earlier property from poisoning namespace state.

reviewed_tests.name: borrowed_call_graph_matches_cloned_rows_and_skips_sibling_bodies
reviewed_tests.reason: Adds 4,096 large sibling-package rows; borrowed graph relations match clone-all reference and mapped route, correct incoming fact is retained, and nine-sample median requires borrowed path less than half cloned-row path. This is an internal perf regression law under synthetic row load as well as edge parity; it may be timing-sensitive but it exercises the borrowed-view optimization.
